scope: THUMB-SPECIFIC: key cores include every checked vertex with any thumb-bone weight; pair tests include every thumb/palm, thumb/neighbor and opposing thumb/hand owned-patch pairing. Other digits unchanged by this candidate are outside this screen. Exact production deformed Human vertices against all 88 actual animated rounded-key inner boxes; original-box nearest-face depth. Whole hand-owned and mixed web vertices included for key cores. Exact noncoplanar edge/triangle intersections for >65%-owned digit/palm patches; mixed web, coplanar and completely enclosed surfaces excluded from pair tests. Counts are not penetration depth or visual approval. Finite sampling cannot establish continuous clearance.
evidenceFormat: Portable numerical report: raw vertex coordinates, triangle-index pairs, bone-weight dumps and workspace paths omitted; all failure cases, counts and thresholds retained.
assetProvenance: Fictional CC0 avatar and procedural piano from this repository; not personal biometric data.
